title: V5 dedup-before-UNIQUE-INDEX migration is the correct upgrade path
description: The DELETE ... WHERE rowid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(rowid) ...) idiom for deduplicating before CREATE UNIQUE INDEX is the right approach for a live upgrade. A future contributor might suggest skipping the dedup (assuming the bug was caught early enough that no duplicates exist in the wild). That assumption is unsafe: the bug window (KITH-orvy.1) was in production long enough that any database that received a retransmitted message would have a duplicate row and the migration would fail. Keep the dedup; it is a no-op on clean databases and correct on dirty ones.
